name: What factors influence the price of a luxury penthouse in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the price of a luxury penthouse in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: The price of a luxury penthouse is primarily influenced by its location, square footage, views, and the exclusivity of the building and its amenities. For instance, a penthouse with direct oceanfront views in Bal Harbour or Fisher Island will typically command a higher price than a comparable unit further inland. The level of customization, designer finishes, and smart home technology also play a significant role in valuation. Understanding these factors helps in setting realistic budget expectations and identifying properties that offer the best value for your specific requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Penthouse prices are influenced by location, square footage, views, building amenities, and customization. Oceanfront properties in exclusive areas like Bal Harbour often have higher price points.
